description:
The page's removal ledger named tuple_refined_demand (jobs/transport.rs) for removal; the fz-rba.3 change kept it and pointed it at decomposed_field_tys. It rewrites a Whole demand on an exact tuple type into a per-field demand before layout derivation; layout_from_demand already asks decomposed_field_tys for the same answer. Establish whether layout derivation can read the type directly at its three call sites so the rewrite and its Cow go away. Unverified; first step is to delete it and read what fails.
Finding recorded from the earlier title (budget derived from the calling convention): not done and not wanted. Cranelift 0.131.3 does not expose the Tail convention's argument register counts (aarch64 8 integer, x86-64 SysV 6), and a target-derived budget would make layouts differ by target, which breaks goldens and three-path parity. The budget is one constant, 8.
title: tuple_refined_demand folds into layout derivation
